IVC 两图绘制素材图册

先阅读 DRAWING_BRIEF.docx。以下是拆分素材，不是最终论文排版。骨架以统一斜投影显示；请与 RGB 并排放置，不要直接叠加到人物像素上。除注意力连线外，各阶段采用同一固定 Unity 样本。所有数值保持原始导出。

SVG 可编辑，PDF 为矢量，PNG 用于预览。图一优先：RGB、raw_left/right、alignment_before_after、fused、output_comparison。图二优先：body_reference、left、right_to_left、cue_*、gate_heatmap、residual_correction。

机制示意 / Schematic connections

attention_connections

Conceptual connections on real poses. Uniform lines; all-joint attention, not only matching-joint links.

真实数据 / Derived from recorded data

temporal_poses

Three representative actual poses for illustration; refiner kernel size remains FIVE.

真实数据 / Derived from recorded data

gate_heatmap

Measured alpha; fixed 0-1 color scale; do not stretch contrast to imply binary switching.

真实数据 / Derived from recorded data

residual_correction

True output correction arrows, no magnification; different from cross-view feature difference.

真实数据 / Derived from recorded data

output_comparison

Same sample/frame/projection/limits; GT canonicalized with original independent batch anchor; no per-panel fitted alignment.
